events.title: North Pole Workshop is Coming to Town December 4th
events.summary: Indie developers Ania Pienio and Michael Szyszko, are excited to announce that their debut game has a release date. North Pole Workshop, a 3D Christmas-themed multiplayer co-op, will officially launch on Steam for PC on December 4, 2026. We have been working on the game for about 2 years now and are very excited to invite players into the magical North Pole Workshop. events.title: Creating a game that's fun for different skill levels or vibe desires
events.summary: I love playing co-op games with my game friends like overcooked, valheim, 7 days, baldur's gate and many others. I also enjoy playing co-op games with my younger nieces and nephews. I created North Pole Workshop with both groups in mind. The levels can be completed without worrying about time, and you can explore the workshops, make toys and deliver them to Santa's sleigh at your own pace; you can beat the whole game like this.
